issue.title: test_web_expands_and_strand_preview_waits_for_audit times out waiting for the pending strand-read status under a loaded check lane

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by sase-1mk.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2, 2026-10-18 15:54Z) during the
v0.18.0 release-blocker epic sase-1mk.

`wait_for(_strand_read_status pending)` timed out after 5s under an escalated
`just check` full lane (ToolRun 3d52f46e53e1e2f43561562bb762dc55, 56426 passed in
61m, `-n 4`). The node passed in isolation on the same tree; HEAD passed 20/20
isolated runs plus two `pytest -n 4` runs of the whole `test_memory_panel.py` module.
The phase's change (archive pulse cursor echo, screenshot settle frame count,
statistics loading) shares no files with the memory panel.

Fail rate: 1 failure in one loaded full lane; 0 failures in 20 serial and 2 module-level
parallel reruns. Root cause not identified; the test waits on a transient `pending`
strand-read status, which a fast audit read may pass through before the 5s poll
observes it.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (escalated full lane, -n 4)

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1mk.4 saw this memory-panel node fail once under a loaded full check lane and pass in isolation; no existing task bead tracks it, so the sase-1mk land agent files it.
